summary: First test iteration for FloGuard marketing site. Backend (5/5 pytest) and frontend (all critical UI flows) passed. Lead form E2E persists to MongoDB and GET /api/leads returns the new lead. Navbar, all 6 pages, testimonials carousel, case studies filters/modal/before-after slider, services accordion, and mobile menu all functional.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid values: two issue chips share testid 'issue-flooded' (because 'Flooded yard / standing water' and 'Flooded patio / lanai' both slice(0,8) => 'flooded'). Duplicates make selectors ambiguous.

action_items: Optional: make LeadForm issue chip data-testids unique (e.g., hash or index) so tests can uniquely target each chip.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: send_lead_email uses asyncio.create_task(fire-and-forget) — OK; RESEND_API_KEY empty properly skips with warning log.
LeadForm data-testid collision on issue chips (slice(0,8)) can bite QA later.
Navbar hides on scroll-down; tests must scrollTo(0,0) before clicking nav links (documented).
seed_data_creation: Created lead records via API: TEST_John Doe (test_john@example.com), TEST_Playwright User (test_playwright@example.com) in db.leads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Playwright: scroll to top before nav clicks (navbar hides on scroll-down). CaseStudies page needs ~1s wait after nav for filter chips to render. Issue chip testids in LeadForm collide (2x issue-flooded). Lead-form submit flow verified end-to-end with MongoDB persistence.
